authority.source_authority: The DAD repository and explicit human gates retain source and execution authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-mcp-writer edits MCP-scoped artifacts; independent-mcp-checker reads the resulting diff and evidence without editing writer scope.

roles.why_needed: One writer prevents overlapping edits to the strict dependency map, server, and fingerprints.
roles.mission: Implement the accepted vendor-neutral MCP dependency, freshness, privacy, and blast-radius contract.
inputs: current MCP source and host adapter bundle
roles.authority: May edit only MCP-related source, schemas, registries, assets, navigation, validation, tests, and documentation; no live host configuration.
acceptance_conditions: Focused MCP tests and repository validation pass.
No mutation or remote authority is introduced.
stop_conditions: A live host configuration write is required.

roles.why_needed: The strict map can otherwise certify its own omissions or weak gates.
roles.mission: Independently verify dependency coverage, stale refusal, privacy, authority, and host claims.
roles.authority: Read-only review; cannot edit writer outputs, self-grade the writer, or authorize execution.
acceptance_conditions: Findings identify false-current paths and missing consumers.
Release gate and disagreement are explicit.
stop_conditions: Evidence is limited to the writer self-grade.

readiness_conditions: MCP-scoped diff and negative probes are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove the map cannot claim current when enforcement, routes, navigation, time, privacy, or authority drift.
